fixed_definition: summaries are computed from p(Z_i=k | theta,gamma,Y) immediately before the existing categorical draw and must leave .Random.seed unchanged
interpretation_limit: the diagnostic is deterministic and consumes no RNG

fixed_definition: SHA-256 of the frozen scientific field list must equal the reviewed K10 fingerprint separately for all 12 tasks
interpretation_limit: any mismatch invalidates the reconstructed task

fixed_definition: component columns refer to the allocation step's pre-relabel, iteration-local labels; they must not be aligned componentwise with relabeled fit$size or fit$Z
interpretation_limit: only label-invariant totals and event totals may be compared after relabeling

fixed_definition: expected occupancy births+deaths per 1000: <1 near-deterministic; <10 sparse; <50 active; otherwise high; method-level low or mobile requires at least 3 of four late chains
interpretation_limit: activity is conditional, not realized joint-chain mixing

fixed_definition: flag when expected occupancy crossings per 1000 <10 and expected substantive threshold crossings per 1000 >=50 in at least 2 of four late chains
interpretation_limit: a threshold-boundary mechanism flag, not a target revision

fixed_definition: flag when the four-chain late range of conditional mean Kocc or Ksub is >=0.5 and its late/middle range ratio is >=0.75
interpretation_limit: a conditioning-state flag, not proof of a posterior mode

fixed_definition: martingale-residual descriptive alert when |z| >4; persistent when middle and late have the same sign and both exceed the limit
interpretation_limit: descriptive sequential calibration screen, not an iid test

fixed_definition: descriptive alert only when conditional expected total >=10 and observed/expected lies outside [0.5,2]
interpretation_limit: descriptive discrepancy only; thresholds are not retuned

fixed_definition: diagnoses one allocation update conditional on the current theta and gamma; it is not a convergence proof, does not change the K10 target, and cannot authorize a formal run
interpretation_limit: all method labels require human review
